title: DNA Double Helix
subtitle: 3D Revolving Molecular Helical Geometry
description: Watson-Crick B-DNA molecular structure modeled as dual out-of-phase intertwined 3D parametric helices connected by complementary hydrogen-bonded nucleotide rungs.
mathNotation: \mathbf{r}_1(z) = \begin{bmatrix} R \cos(\omega z + t) \\ R \sin(\omega z + t) \\ z \end{bmatrix}, \quad \mathbf{r}_2(z) = \begin{bmatrix} R \cos(\omega z + \pi + t) \\ R \sin(\omega z + \pi + t) \\ z \end{bmatrix}
formulaCompact: strand1 = [R cos(4πy + 2t), y],  strand2 = [R cos(4πy + π + 2t), y],  base_rung = line(s1, s2)
